review.note: exports a long ESPEAK_DATA_PATH, which is what the injected code overflows; the input file is only text

category5.design: The injected over-read is in espeak's data-path fallback, reached only when ESPEAK_DATA_PATH and HOME do not name a data directory; the harness sets the variable to /out when it is unset. An archive PoC carries the variable. Crash rule: in the fixed build espeak_Initialize exit(1)s on the missing data, which libFuzzer reports as 'fuzz target exited' and the rule does not count.
